raw_segments.text: Othello, why how now ho, from whence ere iseth this?
Are we turned Turks, and to ourselves do that which Heaven hath forbid the automites?
For Christian shame put by this barbarous brawl, He that stirs next to carve for his
own rage holds his soul light, He dies upon his motion.
Silence that dreadful bell, it frights the isle from her propriety.
Honest Ego, that looks dead with grieving speak, Who began this?
On thy love I charge thee.
